scope: Assertion-intent file-level crosswalk. Existing tests were read; filenames, generated counts, and translation docstrings were not treated as evidence of full parity. Current-source numerical reference tests are a separate layer.

status_definitions.covered: The stated portable behavioral intents have direct Python assertion oracles; language-specific internals may be explicitly excluded.
status_definitions.partial: Some assertion intents have matching Python tests, with concrete untested sections or differing API contracts listed.
status_definitions.not_applicable: This R API/statistic has no Python counterpart; unrelated Python tests cannot count as coverage.
status_definitions.gap: The file’s principal behavior lacks a matching Python oracle or behavior.

fixes_from_assertion_audit.behavior: Remove globally unused categorical levels on the retained sample before final design construction.
fixes_from_assertion_audit.before: Both engines returned 0/10 finite ATT when a pandas categorical declared an unused level; explicitly removing unused categories returned 10/10.
fixes_from_assertion_audit.after: All ATT/SE/fullIF match an explicitly retained/releveled sample, including first/last unused levels and levels removed by missingness or balancing.

fixes_from_assertion_audit.behavior: Propagate observed missing custom-estimator IF through per-unit aggregation, retaining zero only for absent units.
fixes_from_assertion_audit.before: One NaN injected per cell yielded zero NaN IF entries and 10/10 finite SE in both engines.
fixes_from_assertion_audit.after: Exactly one NaN unit IF per cell and all cell SE missing; healthy contributions remain bit-identical.
